messages:
maeve: Quick design check — the new compact threshold row introduces channel folding. when a user collapses channels, should the notification preview be hidden or summarized? toni: I think summarize. hiding feels like information loss for debugging. show a condensed preview line like: "3 channels • 2 previews". keeps row height small. :thinking_face: devin: Agree on summary. Also we need a clear affordance to expand. current chevron size is tiny on mobile. can we 44px touch target? alex: UX copy suggestion: instead of 'Show previews', use 'Preview notifications' — it feels more like an action. For the collapsed state label: '3 channels collapsed — view previews' (link style). maeve: Nice. Accessibility nit: screenreader should announce number of hidden channels and whether previews are present. Proposed aria-label: "3 channels collapsed, 2 previews available, expandable" accessibility-bot: AUTOMATED CHECK: aria-label present? NO — failing for collapsed rows in list view. See example fix below. maeve: snippet for how we envision it: ```
3
``` toni: Also keyboard flow: when focused, pressing Enter expands, but Tab order should go into the expanded channel items. currently focus jumps to the next threshold row — bug. we need to trap focus or programmatically move to first child. devin: On the preview content itself — we should truncate to one line and surface the matching rule highlight (bold) so users can scan. e.g., "[MATCH] high error rate in service-x: 87%". keep microcopy under 100 chars. maeve: Edge case: if collapsed channels have mixed suppression states (some muted, some snoozed) we should show an icon stack: muted + snoozed small badges, maybe `·` separators; and an expanded tooltip listing details. not overload row. alex: Copy tweak for the suppression toggle in the compact row: current label 'Snooze' confuses some PMs. Suggest 'Temporarily silence notifications' in the help tooltip and keep the button as 'Snooze' (short label) for compactness. toni: Visual density question — do we allow two-line collapsed rows on desktop for long channel names? that defeats compactness. probably ellipsize channel names and show full name on hover tooltip. accessibility-bot: AUTOMATED CHECK: contrast ratios for chevrons and collapsed badges are borderline (3.8:1). Recommend increasing to 4.5:1 for WCAG AA on small text. devin: Implementation note: when expanding, animate height over 120ms. avoid layout thrash by animating max-height with JS-calculated value, not auto. Also ensure KV-cache previews are fetched lazily to avoid perf regressions. maeve: Decision checklist before next Figma pass: compact row keeps single-line height, collapsed state shows summary badge ("3 channels • 2 previews"), chevron/touch target increased, aria-label announced, keyboard expand moves into first expanded child, badges icons for mute/snooze, copy tweaks for tooltip. anyone object? toni: no objections from design. will update Figma and copy doc. devin: sounds good — I'll handle the aria + keyboard implementation and add unit tests for focus behaviour. alex: I'll update the copy doc and add the tooltip wording. maeve: thanks team — I'll post an updated screenshot once in figma and follow up with QA checklist. :thumbsup:
